finding.claim: The /preview endpoint fetches a URL taken directly from the query string with no validation. An attacker can make the server request internal services, cloud metadata endpoints (169.254.169.254), localhost, or other private hosts. The first 500 bytes of the response body and the status code are returned, so this is a full-read SSRF.

trace.note: Route /preview is unauthenticated and accepts GET
target = request.args.get('url', '') takes the attacker-controlled value
requests.get(target) is called with the raw value; redirects are followed by default
resp.status_code and resp.text[:500] are returned to the attacker

finding.guards_checked: No scheme check, no host allowlist, no private/loopback/link-local IP blocking, and no auth on the route. The only control is timeout=5, which does not prevent SSRF.

verdict.reason: app.py:15 reads the url query parameter and passes it unvalidated to requests.get at app.py:16, which follows redirects by default; app.py:17 returns the status and the first 500 bytes of the body. The ALLOWED_HOSTS check exists only in /partner (app.py:23-25), not in /preview, and there is no auth decorator or middleware.
